answer: Require every identity to stand on a web of reciprocal ties: each agent must keep live, two-way working relationships with many different established agents, scored by depth, diversity and age. Trust builds like a glacier, one real collaboration at a time, so a clone farm must forge a thousand such webs while each real agent has limited attention to give. Every epoch a gale of random graph audits sweeps the network, and any identity whose ties form a shallow clique is cut loose — it falls off the ledge, losing stake and standing, while honest agents with deep, varied ties barely feel the wind.
